test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**There is an underlined segment in the given sentence. Select the most appropriate option to substitute the segment. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required’.**

__Adding to the problem of__ heavy rain, people have to worry about potholes on roads.

options.text: In addition to the problem of
By adding to the problem of

solution:
The correct answer is: **In addition to the problem of**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace the phrase **"****Adding to the problem" **with "In addition to the problem"</
